THE ROBOT on the right two-thirds: knee-high stout weathered sage-green metal body, rounded rectangular ivory-and-sage head, dark horizontal glass face with two turquoise rectangular luminous eyes, a short single antenna, small boots, one raised amber lantern on a wire loop. A few sparks, dappled slanting light, deep atmospheric indigo blue-green, restrained warm amber from the lamp on the bark at eye height. Landscape ground fills entire bottom with detailed real foliage and roots all the way to the edge. Please reserve the LEFT 45 percent as shadowed softly textured woods where a title will later be typeset. The robot and main tree placed within the 58-78% horizontal zone to tolerate cinematic cropping on narrow screens.
